entries.1530062b5cdedcc9: The company and its China-based development subsidiary, Kelai Ruanjian Kaifa (Shanghai) Youxian Gongsi (KLab China Inc.), plan and develop mobile online games using IP. Amounts are disclosed collectively within the segment and are not printed individually.
entries.28f0ba52ad4240ad: A company that plans, develops, and operates mobile online games using manga and anime IP, and is also nurturing new AI-related businesses.
entries.3cedce916af430b6: This is the group's only reportable segment, which plans, develops and operates mobile online games centered on smartphone apps. Its titles are mainly based on IP from manga and anime, and it operates titles including 'BLEACH Brave Souls' and 'Captain Tsubasa: Dream Team'. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,365 million.

entries.655d2a9a092bdb0b: This is a business category not included in the reportable segments. The business engages in contract game production, anime investment, sales and operation/maintenance of GPU cloud servers, development of AI talent, AI talent production, and AI creative production for businesses, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥490 million.
